_comment: Change log for the UnyBase app. Append-only and oldest first: add each new change at the END, dated the day it ships, in the same commit as the change. Audiences: everyone, client, shared (people a client shared credentials with), technical_admin, super_admin, internal (admin change log only, never in the What's new popup). Types: new, improved, fixed, security, removed. A new screen's tour step ids go in tourSteps; scripts/check-guide.mjs fails the build if a tour step has no change log entry or the log is out of order. See CLAUDE.md.

entries.title: The UnyBase dashboard is live
entries.summary: Sign up, log in and land on your own workspace at unybase.unywebs.com.

entries.title: Three kinds of account
entries.summary: Super admins run the platform, technical admins work in the client workspaces they're granted, and clients manage their own.
details: Roles come from the user_roles table and the SUPER_ADMIN_EMAILS / TECHNICAL_ADMIN_EMAILS settings.

entries.title: Subscription admin
entries.summary: One table of every workspace's payment status, worst first, with a cut-off switch that always needs a person to confirm it.
details: Grace, warning, escalated and cutoff-recommended stages, worked out live from the last failed payment.
Type CUTOFF to confirm; Restore brings everything back with the same key.
Every cutoff and restore is kept in an audit trail.

entries.title: Your subscription at a glance
entries.summary: The Overview page shows whether your plan is paid up, along with your workspace key.

entries.title: The credential vault
entries.summary: Keep every key, token and login your apps depend on in one place, encrypted before it is stored and tested against the provider.
details: Live checks for GitHub, Supabase, systeme.io, ClickUp, Vercel and any web address.
Expiry dates tracked, with problems sorted to the top.
Record whose account each credential belongs to: yours or the agency's.

entries.title: Email warnings before things break
entries.summary: UnyBase now re-checks your credentials every night and emails you before anything expires or after something fails.
details: An alert as soon as a working credential starts failing.
Payment, trial and access emails at each step of your account.

entries.title: Give your developer access
entries.summary: Grant a technical admin access to your workspace from Settings, with an optional end date, and take it back any time.

entries.title: Import existing subscribers
entries.summary: Add existing customers in bulk from the Subscriptions page, so they get accounts without signing up themselves.

entries.title: Group credentials by app or system
entries.summary: Tag each credential with the app, tool or system it belongs to, then filter the vault by it.

entries.title: Reset a forgotten password
entries.summary: Use Forgot password? on the login page to get a link to set a new one. Replies to our emails now reach support.

entries.title: Billing exemption for internal accounts
entries.summary: Mark a company workspace as internal so it never shows up as unpaid.

entries.title: Share credentials with your developer
entries.summary: Give someone access to all your credentials or just one system, for as long as you choose. They see exactly what you shared, labelled with your email.

entries.title: Domains, any provider, and light or dark
entries.summary: Track where each domain is registered and when it renews, store credentials for any provider, and switch the whole app between light and dark.

entries.title: Reveal a stored credential
entries.summary: Show or copy a credential when you need it. It hides again by itself, and every reveal is logged in its history.

entries.title: Pricing shows the yearly saving in dollars
entries.summary: The UnyBase website's pricing cards show how much yearly billing saves, and browsers no longer hold on to old prices.

entries.title: Clearer sign-up and email confirmation
entries.summary: Type your password twice when signing up, confirm your email from your inbox, and land on the right next step.

entries.title: Choose your plan before you start
entries.summary: New accounts pick Basic or Premium, monthly or yearly, and pay at the secure checkout. The dashboard opens as soon as the payment arrives.

entries.title: Manual trials
entries.summary: Give an account free access until a date you choose. They're reminded before it ends, and see the plan picker afterwards.

entries.title: Change requests
entries.summary: Write down every edit you want made to your apps, send a batch to your developer in one copy, and tick them off when they're done.

entries.title: systeme.io tags for signups and customers
entries.summary: Signups and paying customers are tagged in systeme.io automatically, with a Sync tags now button and a log of every attempt.

entries.title: Plan, billing cycle and cancellation tags
entries.summary: systeme.io contacts are also tagged with their plan (Basic or Premium), billing cycle and cancellation, so each can be emailed separately.

entries.title: Yearly prices match checkout
entries.summary: The yearly prices shown in UnyBase now match what checkout charges: $299.95 for Basic and $499.95 for Premium.

entries.title: A visual user guide
entries.summary: Every page and button explained with annotated screenshots, in light and dark.

entries.title: Website shows the real dashboard
entries.summary: The UnyBase website now has a tour of the real dashboard, copy that matches the product, and the same plan lists as the app.

entries.title: Client sites: the kill switch
entries.summary: Every client app Unywebs builds can check in with UnyBase and be paused from Admin, Client sites, without logging into the client's tool.
details: Auto follows the owner's account; Paused shows visitors a neutral unavailable page; Always on ignores the account.
Keys are shown once, and every switch is logged and emailed to the owner.
Nothing pauses on its own: a failed payment only shows the client's staff a notice.

entries.title: Cutting off an account also pauses its sites
entries.summary: The cut-off dialog now says how many client sites are linked to the account. Those on Auto show the unavailable page until you restore.

entries.title: Licence check for client apps
entries.summary: A public status endpoint, a drop-in script for static sites, and a builder prompt that adds the check to any app Claude builds.

entries.title: A step-by-step getting-started tour
entries.summary: Help in the menu now opens a tour of every screen with real screenshots, with a track for each kind of user.
details: Getting started for everyone, plus Shared access, Technical admin and Super admin tracks.
Steps added since your last visit are marked New.

entries.title: Menu readable in light mode and on phones
entries.summary: The top menu now follows the light theme, and on a phone it scrolls on its own row instead of pushing the page sideways.

entries.title: The tour can't fall behind the app
entries.summary: Every build checks that each page has a tour step, and GitHub re-takes all screenshots on every push, committing only real changes.

entries.title: What's new, the first time you log in after an update
entries.summary: When UnyBase changes in a way that affects you, a short walkthrough of the changes opens the next time you log in. It shows once, on any device.
details: You only see changes that apply to your kind of account.
Every past update is listed on the What's new page, linked from Help.

entries.title: Change log in Admin
entries.summary: Admin has a Change log tab: every change to UnyBase in date order, with who it affects, searchable and exportable as CSV or JSON.
details: Super admins also see internal notes about the website, builds and infrastructure.
Technical admins now get the admin tabs too, with Subscriptions and Change log.
